lines.1: "Damn it... One look at Fukahire's score will soothe my wounded heart."
lines.2: "I wonder what Fukahire got. I really don't want to lose to him."
lines.3: I could hear the groans of everyone who had gotten a bad score.
lines.4: 「The line to compare scores with Fukahire starts here! No pushing, please!」
lines.5: 「First five people, raise your right hands! All right, move along in order!」
lines.7: 「You really are popular whenever tests come back, Fukahire.」
lines.8: 「Like I keep saying... that doesn't make me happy!」
lines.9: 「All right, all right. You can lick each other's wounds later. Take your seats now, please. We are resuming class.」
